attributes.during:
When you would encounter the villain Corrupted Herald, any character that has the Herald's Heart in hand moves to your location and encounters the villain instead.

When you win the scenario, each character may move. A character may then summon and encounter the villain Baphomet; if he is defeated, add the loot Amulet of the Abyss to the reward.
